title: potentilla acaulis subsp. tommasiniana
intro: Potentilla acaulis subsp. tommasiniana, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla acaulis subsp. tommasiniana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
